program: Health First Colorado (Colorado Medicaid) dental, administered by DentaQuest
notes: HCPF's provider rates page lists the 'Dental Fee Schedule' only as a link to DentaQuest (https://www.dentaquest.com/state-plans/regions/colorado/health-first-colorado/provider-page/), which returns 403 (Akamai) to curl and WebFetch; DentaQuest content/dam PDFs are also blocked. The HCPF Health First Colorado physician fee schedule (01_CO_Fee Schedule_Health First Colorado_07012026 v1.4.xlsx, kept in raw/CO) contains no D-codes. Per DentaQuest's July 2026 newsletter (search snippet, not opened), dental FFS rates were cut 2% across the board effective 2026-07-01 and adults have a $3,000 annual maximum from 2026-07-01. An HCPF rate-review Appendix H with 07/01/2024 dental rates exists but is outdated, so not used. No fee recorded.
notes_2024: Source is an official HCPF document, 'Appendix H: DIDD and Medicaid Dental Rates w/ Benchmark Ratios' (2025 MPRRAC rate review), tab 'CO Medicaid Dental Rate_Adult' = adult portion of the CO Medicaid State Plan dental fee schedule, column 'Total CO Medicaid FFS Allowable Effective 07/01/2024'. Not the fee schedule file itself. Listed age ranges are 0-999 for most codes (D0330 6+, D1110 12+, D4355 13+), so recorded as 'all'; child-only codes (D1120, D1351, D2930, D3220, D8xxx ortho) are not in this adult tab and therefore absent, not necessarily uncovered. D9223/D9243 base-value cells are garbled in the PDF text; the clean total column was used ($100.09).
